title: Phantasia BtfA: Gridcrawler Blobber with Content Creator
author: Epyx911
selftext:
After I finished my 2d party based CRPG (Full game with story campaign)...I wanted to create a GridCrawler in the spirit of Legend of Grimrock but with Wizardry style turn based combat.   Taking the things I had learned about the iteration process. This one like the first has a full content creator to create the game and debug as I go along.  
  
I used the following tools:  
  
\- [Meshy.ai](http://Meshy.ai) for some of the town buildings and all of the monsters. Monsters were done with the prompting I had learned to maintain consistancy of models and art in ChatGPT then turned into 3d models in Meshy.ai.

\- Most of the town is from Unity Asset Packs...dungeon shown was done in Blender.

\- I used Blender via MCP with Astra at first but honestly Opus 5.5 just blew it out of the water for combat animations/idle etc.

\- All music via Suno

\- Speech via ElevenLabs latest model

I used the same ruleset I used for my 2d CRPG but altered it for the first person combat.  If anyone is interested I will show the content creator portion which is pretty cool...let's me build full campaigns/levels etc.  Content creator also handles full dialogue trees/quests etc...pretty much anything you can imagine...also pulls in FBX files.

Once I have all the visuals dialed in and UI I will complete the Campaign which I have already built the story for.
